caption: Den Gamle By, Aarhus
composition: Cobbled museum square of half-timbered houses after closing · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Inside Den Gamle By, the cobbled square is lined with half-timbered merchant houses, red tile roofs, and small-paned windows. It is an overcast night, about 13.5°C, with wind near 16 km/h and historic-style lamps still on. The museum is not on a late-evening summer schedule in late September, so the square is empty and there are no modern cars. Individual house identities in the generated square were not matched beam by beam to the museum plan.
